title: Manifest font claims (tnum, monospace, version, weight) are never read from the binaries
body:
## Summary
fonts/fonts.manifest.json declares tnum, monospace, numeric_ok, version and source per face, and tokens.css declares weight ranges, but no gate compared any of them to the woff2 files; DESIGN.md promises a CI tnum check that did not exist.

## Description
packages/design-tokens/src/fonts-integrity.test.ts:58-85 verified sha256 and the OFL licence file only. DESIGN.md:346 says 'CI check rejects faces without tnum on numeric layers' and DESIGN.md:570 (M0) 'fonts/ with the default set + manifest + tnum check'; git grep for a GSUB/tnum read found none. The manifest's `tnum` and `numeric_ok` are what the generation agent reads (apps/server/src/generation/refs.ts:103 copies the manifest into the LLM refs), so a re-subset that drops the tnum feature (the pending '->' glyph fix is exactly such a re-subset) would ship a manifest that lies. Technique: design-tokens/token-enforcement ('the gate must read what ships'). Fixed: a minimal WOFF2 reader in the test reads name 0/1/5, GSUB feature tags, post.isFixedPitch, OS/2 usWeightClass and the fvar wght range and compares them with the manifest and tokens.css.

## Flow
- re-subset a face (e.g. to add U+2192) with a tool that drops GSUB tnum
- sha256 updated in the manifest, tnum left true
- before: all gates green; after: 'tnum: binary false vs manifest true' fails

## Expected impact
Whoever re-subsets a font (the open '->' card) learns at test time if tnum, the version string or the wght axis changed. Could break: nothing at runtime; test-only.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - manifest claims verified against the binary
Before: 0 of 42 per-face claims checked (6 faces x family, source_url, version, tnum, monospace, numeric_ok, weight)
After: 42 of 42 checked; seeded: manifest monospace/version flipped on disk -> 2 tests red; in-suite seeded control flips tnum, version, weight, numeric_ok
Method: gate - red-then-green test on the real files
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
probe output (scratch reader over fonts/*.woff2):
BarlowCondensed-*: GSUB feats ccmp dnom frac liga locl numr pnum tnum; isFixedPitch 0; OS/2 500/600/700/800
Inter-Variable: tnum true; fvar wght 100-900; Version 4.001;git-66647c0bb
JetBrainsMono-Variable: tnum false; isFixedPitch 1; fvar wght 100-800
DESIGN.md:346, DESIGN.md:570; packages/design-tokens/src/fonts-integrity.test.ts:58-85 (before)

title: videoTheme parity test pinned 6 of 11 colour keys to the studio tokens
body:
## Summary
video-theme.test.ts checked background, surface, ink, accent, accentInk and grid against theme-photofinish.css; inkDim, inkFaint, captionBox, captionInk and captionActive were hand copies with no parity check.

## Description
packages/design-tokens/src/index.ts:52-65 copies the Photo Finish palette into videoTheme with comments naming each source token; packages/design-tokens/src/video-theme.test.ts:40-47 (before) named six keys. A retune of --color-text-muted, --color-text-dim or --color-bg-raised would leave the video frames on the old values. Technique: design-tokens/cross-language-token-parity (a mirror is generated or gated). Fixed with a Record<Exclude<keyof VideoTheme,'fonts'>, string> map (compile-time exhaustive), a runtime key-set check, captionBox compared by rgb, fonts === fontFamilies.

## Flow
- retune --color-text-dim in theme-photofinish.css
- before: video-theme.test.ts stays green, videos keep #56616c
- after: 'inkFaint = --color-text-dim' fails

## Expected impact
Studio and video stay on one palette (ADR 009 point 6). Could break: nothing; test-only.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every video colour pinned to its token
Before: 6 of 11 colour keys pinned
After: 11 of 11; seeded inkFaint #57616c and captionBox rgb 246 each red; an extra key fails tsc (TS2353)
Method: gate - red-then-green test
Result: better
Gate: none

title: On-colour pairs (button, brand, status-go, player-frame inks) had no contrast floor
body:
## Summary
theme-contrast.test.ts gated text tokens on the four light grounds only; the -ink tokens that sit on fills (primary button and its hover, brand, status-go, the dark player frame) were outside every floor.

## Description
packages/design-tokens/src/theme-contrast.test.ts:59-72 TEXT_TOKENS is a hand list of light-ground text. --color-primary-ink (apps/studio/src/styles/base.css:133), --color-brand-ink (heatmap.css:1098), --status-go-ink (board.css:655) and --color-screen-ink/-ink-2 (base.css:1021-1059, board.css:322-1061) are text on fills nobody gated. Technique: design-tokens/token-enforcement (every foreground/surface pairing meets its ratio, read from the theme). Fixed: pairs derived from the naming rule --X-ink[-N] on --X, --X-N, --X-hover (a new -ink token is gated without a list edit; an -ink with no fill fails).

## Flow
- retune --color-screen-ink-2 darker for the player frame
- before: all contrast tests green
- after: '--color-screen-ink-2 on --color-screen' fails at 2.45:1

## Expected impact
Player-frame captions/labels and button text keep AA. Could break: a future -ink token without a matching fill name fails until named (intended).

## Evaluation

Before: 0 of 8 on-colour pairs gated (today all pass: lowest screen-ink-2 on screen-2 6.54:1)
After: 8 of 8 gated; seeded #4a5560 -> 2.45:1 red
Method: gate - red-then-green test against the parsed theme
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Zero-reference token gate counts a comment that names a token as a use
body:
## Summary
token-parity.test.ts matched token names in raw source; index.ts comments name every videoTheme source token, so a token whose last var() reference is removed stayed 'used'.

## Description
packages/design-tokens/src/token-parity.test.ts:66-85 (before) joined raw file text; packages/design-tokens/src/index.ts:53-61 carries '// --color-bg', '// --color-text-dim' etc. scan-sweep §7.8: a source-scanning gate must strip comments before it matches. Technique: design-tokens/token-enforcement (a clean run is not evidence a rule is armed). Fixed: comments stripped (urls kept), predicate extracted and pinned by a seeded case.

## Flow
- declare --seed-x in shared.css, mention it only in an index.ts comment
- before: HEAD gate 119/119 green
- after: '--seed-x is declared but nothing references it'

## Expected impact
Unused tokens cannot hide behind documentation. Could break: a // inside a string can make a token look unused (fails loud, never silent).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - unused-token gate cannot be satisfied by prose
Before: seeded comment-only token passes (119/119)
After: seeded token fails; unseeded tree 119/119 (no live token is comment-only today)
Method: gate - same seed against HEAD test and new test
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
scratch probe (comments stripped vs raw over apps/studio/src + packages/*/src): 0 tokens differ today
packages/design-tokens/src/index.ts:53-61 token names in // comments

title: Font arm for the missing '->' glyph: re-subset the three faces with U+2190-2193
body:
## Summary
All six video faces lack U+2190 and U+2192 (Barlow Condensed also lacks U+2191/U+2193), yet EraAdjustedFrame and a fixture headline set '->'; this is the font-file arm of the open Viz Primitives card.

## Description
Routed here per the brief: the font files and manifest are in this context. cmap probe: BarlowCondensed-500..800 miss 2190,2191,2192,2193; Inter-Variable and JetBrainsMono-Variable miss 2190,2192 (Google 'latin' subset carries only the up/down arrows). Render-path users: packages/compositions/src/EraAdjustedFrame.tsx:279 (`${ordinal} ->` in Barlow), packages/schemas/src/fixtures.ts:29. Chromium falls back per glyph to a system face (not OFL from fonts/, CLAUDE.md Fonts). Arm F (this card): re-subset from the SAME upstream OFL sources and versions already in the manifest (source_url unchanged, never a new font source), unicode-range latin + U+2190-2193, update sha256/distribution, regenerate scripts/font-metrics.mjs output. Arm D (viz-primitives card): draw the arrow / replace the glyph. Unknown: whether Barlow 1.408 upstream has the arrows at all - if not, arm F is not-better for the display face and arm D wins.

## Flow
- worker: fetch upstream TTFs at the manifest versions (jpt/barlow 1.408, rsms/inter 4.001, JetBrainsMono 2.211)
- cmap-probe the upstream files for U+2190/2192 (instrument)
- subset latin + arrows, keep GSUB tnum (fonts-integrity claims gate 8c4493d now pins it)
- update manifest sha256 + distribution; node scripts/font-metrics.mjs; vitest packages/design-tokens packages/viz
- compare with arm D on the same instrument

## Expected impact
Era payoff and any arrow render in the OFL face, deterministically. Could break: font metrics (regenerated table), file size (+~1 KB/face).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - glyphs on the render path come from fonts/
Before: U+2192 missing in 6 of 6 faces; 2 render-path strings use it
After: not measured - needs the upstream sources (network fetch) and a subsetter (fontTools not installed)
Method: simulation - probe of the shipped binaries only; the upstream glyph set and the subset build need a fetch this round may not do
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
scratch cmap probe: BarlowCondensed-500 missing 2190,2191,2192,2193,2009,2007; Inter-Variable missing 2190,2192,2007; JetBrainsMono-Variable missing 2190,2192,2009,2007
packages/viz/src/font-metrics.generated.ts:16,:20,:32 (0 = missing)
.claude/scan-history/findings/viz-primitives.jsonl line 11 (arm D)
instrument: cmap probe over fonts/*.woff2 for U+2190-2193 (0 missing = pass) plus the fonts-integrity claims gate staying green; A/B against the viz-primitives drawn-arrow arm

title: Small text set in --color-signal (the 3:1 stroke token) at 3.8-4.1:1
body:
## Summary
Four studio rules paint body-size text in --color-signal, the finish-line stroke token that only promises 3:1; the error toast text sits at 3.81:1 on its raised band.

## Description
theme-photofinish.css:27 defines --color-signal as 'the finish hairline itself'; text in the signal colour is --color-brand (theme-photofinish.css:24, gated 4.5:1). Violations: apps/studio/src/board/undo.css:24 .bd-toast__err on --color-bg-raised (3.81:1, error message), apps/studio/src/board/board.css:2167 .bd-busy, apps/studio/src/board/jobs.css:224 .jlog__live (mono, on --color-surface 4.09:1), apps/studio/src/board/board.css:1742 .bd-style__mark--locked (11 px caps). Display-size uses (front-pf.css:1445, :1473) and the dark slate (base.css:1055, 4.56:1) are fine. Technique: design-tokens/token-taxonomy (role misuse) + token-enforcement (contrast floor per pairing). Fix: those four rules take --color-brand; add a gate in theme-contrast.test.ts like the existing lane-text rule (theme-contrast.test.ts:145-149) that no studio CSS sets `color: var(--color-signal)` outside an allow-listed display selector.

## Flow
- trigger a failed board decision -> undo toast shows the error in --color-signal on bg-raised
- measured 3.81:1 < 4.5:1
- fix: color var(--color-brand) -> 5.98+ on the same ground

## Expected impact
Error and live-status text readable at AA. Could break: hue shifts from the clay-red signal to the darker brand red (same family).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - small signal-coloured text reaches AA
Before: 4 small-text rules at 3.81-4.09:1 (below 4.5)
After: predicted 4 of 4 >= 5.18:1 with --color-brand (5.18 sheet, 5.57 raised, 5.98 surface); not built - sites are in board/undo/jobs CSS (other contexts)
Method: probe - contrast computed for each rule's ground; the fix sites are outside this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
git grep 'color: var(--color-signal)' apps/studio/src -> board.css:1742, board.css:2167, jobs.css:224, undo.css:24, base.css:1055, front-pf.css:1445, front-pf.css:1473
contrast #e4432a on #f5f7f9 = 3.81, on #ffffff = 4.09, on #0f1317 = 4.56
instrument: theme-contrast.test.ts source rule: no `color: var(--color-signal)` in studio CSS outside display-size selectors (seed one, watch it fail)

title: Calendar warning stripe uses decorative --color-floodlight-warm at 2.60:1
body:
## Summary

## Description
apps/studio/src/styles/calendar.css:612 border-left: 3px solid var(--color-floodlight-warm); theme-photofinish.css:32. Perfect direction lane-mark-contrast-gate (52534b6) moved lane-6 off #d4820e because 2.60 < 3:1. A warning marker is status vocabulary (registry status-vocabulary; theme-photofinish.css:42 'status ... always paired with a glyph + label'), so the stripe should be --status-ask (#935700, 5.05:1 on the sheet, already gated), after which --color-floodlight-warm has zero consumers and is deleted (token-parity zero-reference gate enforces it). Note: theme-photofinish.css is reserved by the cards session - wait for that merge before the token deletion.

## Flow

- stripe at 2.60:1 on --color-bg
- fix: calendar.css:612 -> var(--status-ask); delete --color-floodlight-warm

## Expected impact
Warning stripe visible and in the status vocabulary. Could break: stripe hue amber -> darker amber.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - warning marker meets 3:1 and uses the status token
Before: 1 warning marker at 2.60:1 via a decorative token
After: predicted 1 at >= 3:1 via --status-ask; 1 fewer token
Method: probe - contrast computed; fix site is calendar.css (another context) and the token file is reserved
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
git grep floodlight-warm -> apps/studio/src/styles/calendar.css:612 only
contrast #d4820e on #eceff2 = 2.60, on #ffffff = 3.00

title: Studio CSS references an undefined token --font-body; no gate checks var() names exist
body:
## Summary
studio.css uses var(--font-body, inherit) but the vocabulary is --font-ui; nothing checks that referenced tokens exist, so typos and retired names fall back silently.

## Description
apps/studio/src/styles/studio.css:2059 font-family: var(--font-body, inherit); shared.css:6-8 defines --font-display/--font-ui/--font-mono only. token-parity.test.ts checks declared -> used, never used -> declared. Technique: design-tokens/token-enforcement 'Vocabulary membership: names referenced by consumers exist in the authority' (allow-list, not deny-list). Probe over apps/studio/src + packages/*/src + index.html: 152 distinct var() names, 1 undefined token (--font-body); --o (local param with fallback) and the dynamic --ident-/--licence- builders are legitimate. Fix: add the reverse gate to token-parity.test.ts (every var(--x) is a token or a custom property declared somewhere in the tree) and change studio.css:2059 to `inherit` (pixel-identical: the var never resolved).

## Flow
- write the reverse gate -> red on studio.css:2059
- replace var(--font-body, inherit) with inherit -> green

## Expected impact
Retired or misspelt tokens fail the gate instead of silently inheriting. Could break: nothing visual (fallback already in effect).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every referenced token exists
Before: 1 undefined token reference of 152; 0 gates
After: predicted 0 undefined, 1 gate; not built - the gate cannot be green without editing studio.css (another context, possibly in flight)
Method: probe - scratch scan of declarations vs var() references with comments stripped
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: probe: refs 152, decl 204, undefined: --font-body (apps/studio/src/styles/studio.css:2059), --o (base.css:730,1095 local with fallback), --ident-/--licence- (dynamic)
instrument: reverse membership test in token-parity.test.ts, seeded with var(--font-bodyx)

title: The 28 px video text floor is five hand constants, not a token
body:

Technique: design-tokens/cross-language-token-parity (one vocabulary, one authority). Fix: export videoType = { floorPx: 28 } from packages/design-tokens/src/index.ts and import it at the four code sites (the board script may keep a copy gated by a parity test).

## Flow

- migrate Callout, DataClock, DataRace layout to import it

A future floor change (e.g. 30 px) is one edit. Could break: nothing if values are equal.

## Evaluation

Before: 4 code literals + 2 comments
After: predicted 1 authority, 0 literals; not built - consumers are in viz/compositions/board (other contexts)

Result: better

title: Eight derived colours in the theme are rgba/hex hand copies of other tokens
body:
## Summary
The washes, deco, scrim and shadow repeat their base tokens' rgb by hand (and --shadow-panel embeds #c6ced5 = --color-line); all agree today, nothing pins them.

## Description
packages/design-tokens/src/theme-photofinish.css:26 brand-wash (228,67,42 = --color-signal), :33 deco (= --color-text-dim), :34 scrim (= --color-text), :48-50 status washes (= their statuses), :119 --shadow-panel '0 1px 0 #c6ced5' (= --color-line) and rgba(18,22,26) (= --color-text). A retune of a base leaves its wash on the old hue. Fix: color-mix(in srgb, var(--x) N%, transparent) and var(--color-line) in the shadow, or a gate that each rgba() rgb equals a declared hex token. Reserved file: theme-photofinish.css belongs to the cards session until it merges.

## Flow
- retune --status-go
- --status-go-wash keeps the old green
- fix: derive or gate

## Expected impact
Washes follow their base colour. Could break: color-mix rounding (sub-1 rgb).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - derived colours follow their base
Before: 8 hand-derived values, 0 pinned (all 8 agree today)
After: predicted 8 derived or pinned
Method: probe - rgb compared by hand for all 8; file reserved, not built
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: token test: every rgba()/embedded hex in the theme resolves to a declared base token (seed a drift, watch it fail)

title: Five single-theme tokens bound to identity values survive from the removed On Air theme
body:
## Summary
--shape-slant 0deg, --glow-brand none, --control-clip none, --control-case none and --control-tracking 0 exist only so On Air could rebind them; 14 consumer sites apply no-ops.

## Description
theme-photofinish.css:97,98,102,105,120. ADR 009 made Photo Finish the only theme. Consumers: base.css (shape-slant x4, glow-brand, control-clip, control-case, control-tracking), studio.css (glow-brand, control-clip), board.css (control-case, control-tracking). Technique: design-tokens/token-taxonomy (a role earns existence by recurring intent) and the golden path's 'deletion-is-not-repair' (migrate consumers, then delete). Fix: inline the identity (drop the declarations at 14 sites), then delete the five tokens; zero-reference gate proves it.

## Flow
- remove the 14 consumer declarations (pixel-identical)
- delete the five tokens
- token-parity gate green

## Expected impact
Smaller vocabulary; no visual change. Could break: a skew/clip-path drop changes layout if a site combined values (check each).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no tokens that only carry a removed theme
Before: 5 identity tokens, 14 consumer sites
After: predicted 0 and 0; not built - consumers in studio CSS (other contexts), token file reserved
Method: probe - git grep counts
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: screenshot/computed-style equality of the 14 sites before/after plus the zero-reference gate
